run_fal_client_subscribe: run fal_client.subscribe to generate a video from an image and text prompt using a fal.ai model
create_on_queue_update: create an on_queue_update callback to print in-progress logs from a fal_client.subscribe job
encode_image_base64: encode a local image file to base64 format for use as an image_url argument in fal_client.subscribe
run_fal_client_inprogress: check if a fal_client update is an InProgress instance to stream model execution logs
run_fal_client_subscribe_with_logs: run fal_client.subscribe with with_logs=True and a callback to monitor image-to-video generation progress
